# Anatomy kit (vendored)

`iso-kit.mjs` and `iso.css` come from [Anatomy](https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy)
by Ryan (@wheresryan22), MIT licensed (see `LICENSE`). sidegig uses them at build
time only, in `scripts/build-figures.mjs`, to draw its isometric figures; the
generated SVG lives in `src/ui/figures/`.
